findings.issue: Later foreign acquisitions can restore previously observed deductions from net-owned inventory while base fees are unposted.
findings.reproduction: An owned 1-unit BUY yields 0.9975 net; a later manual BUY adds 9.975 net; the engine exits 1 instead of 0.9975, consuming 0.0025 foreign units.
findings.required_resolution: Durable net-owned entitlement and segregation of later external acquisitions; no double fee deduction or invented ownership restoration.

findings.issue: Marketable entry replay uses an unlimited market order rather than the live ask-priced limit.
findings.reproduction: Decision ask 100.06 with 0.1 available there and deeper liquidity at 200; replay fills remaining quantity at 200 although the live limit cannot.
findings.required_resolution: Match live entry limit, partial remainder and TTL semantics; retain market execution only for applicable exits.
